name: agent-browser
title_zh: 浏览器操作先截屏再动手，每一步都看得见
tagline_zh: 不用猜页面状态，先截屏再点击、填表、切标签。并行开多个浏览器会话也不乱，失败时告诉你卡在哪一步。
tagline_en: Stop guessing page states. Snapshot, then click, fill, switch tabs. Run parallel sessions without chaos; failures.
desc_en: Core agent-browser usage guide. Read this before running any agent-browser commands. Covers the snapshot-and-ref workflow, navigating pages, interacting with elements (click, fill, type, select), extracting text and data, taking screenshots, managing tabs, handling forms and auth, waiting for content, running multiple browser sessions in parallel, and troubleshooting common failures. Use when the
why_zh: 把「截屏-操作-再截屏」做成默认节奏，每次动作前都有真实页面依据，不是盲点盲填。失败信息具体到哪一步。
why_en: It bakes snapshot-verify-act into every step, grounding each action in a real page view. Errors name the failing step, so you.
limit_zh: 只驱动真实浏览器，不碰无头模式；需要本机已装 Chrome/Chromium。截屏是静态快照。
limit_en: Real browser only, no headless; needs local Chrome/Chromium. Snapshots miss dynamic popups or lazy-loaded content—wait manually.
title_en: Screenshot-first browser control: see each step before you.
